The HTC Tornado is a smartphone model designed by High Tech Computer Corporation and powered by the Windows Mobile 5 operating system.[1] It has QVGA display resolution.[2]

The Tornado is rebranded as at least 9 different models: the Dopod 586W,[3] Qtek 8300,[4] T-Mobile USA SDA (AKA SDA II), Cingular 2125, i-mate SP5[5] and Orange SPV C600.[6] These individual companies customize the operating system and sell it as a consumer package.

Features

  • 240 x 320 pixels TFT display (65k colors)
  • 1.3-megapixel camera
  • 64 MB SDRAM, 64 MB Flash ROM, miniSD card slot
  • TI OMAP 850, 200 MHz processor
  • EDGE, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Infrared
